cases.input: We need a React frontend with a Python API for an internal employee dashboard. The dashboard should display employee information, project assignments, and work hours. We have an existing PostgreSQL database we can connect to. Timeline: 6 weeks. Budget: $50,000.
cases.notes: Straightforward web development project with clear scope, timeline, and budget.

cases.input: Mobile app for iOS and Android to track personal fitness goals. Features: workout logging, progress charts, social sharing, notifications. We want native apps, not cross-platform. 8 weeks, $75,000.
cases.notes: Clear mobile project with native platform specification.

cases.input: Build a content management system (CMS) for managing blog posts, media, and user roles. Must support multiple authors, revision history, and SEO optimization. Technology: Next.js frontend, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL. 4 weeks.
expected_missing_information: Expected number of blog posts per month
cases.notes: Clear tech stack specified. Well-defined scope.

cases.input: E-commerce platform for selling digital and physical products. Shopping cart, payment processing (Stripe), inventory management, order fulfillment tracking. 3 months, need it live for holiday season.
cases.notes: Clear timeline pressure. High business urgency.

cases.input: We need a system that classifies customer support tickets using historical labeled data and automatically routes them by category. High-priority tickets should escalate to human agents. We have 2 years of historical ticket data. Expected volume: 500 tickets/day.
expected_requirements: Historical data ingestion (2 years of tickets)
cases.notes: Clear ML use case with existing training data.

cases.input: Build a recommendation engine for our e-commerce platform. Recommend products based on browsing history and purchase patterns. We want personalized recommendations for each user. We have 1 million historical transactions.
cases.notes: Standard recommendation problem with data available.

cases.input: Every morning collect sales data from our three branch locations (CSV exports), clean it, and send a summary dashboard to the operations team. Also flag any anomalies like unusually high or low sales. We need this running by next Monday.
expected_requirements: Daily data collection from 3 branch CSVs
cases.notes: Clear automation workflow. Short timeline.

cases.input: Automate our invoice processing. We receive 100+ PDFs per day from customers with various formats. Extract invoice number, amount, due date, and customer info. Validate and categorize. Feed into our accounting system.
cases.notes: High-volume document automation with variable formats.
